title: Atmus Announces Kevin Carpenter as SVP, Chief Supply Chain Officer
summary: Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc. (Atmus; NYSE: ATMU), a global leader in filtration and media solutions, today announced the appointment of Kevin Carpenter as Senior Vice President and Chief Supply Chain Officer, effective immediately. Carpenter brings more than 25 years of experience leading global industrial organizations through transformation, growth and operational excellence.
